subsegment_name: Swedish Pomerania - NOT a Brandenburg frontier in 1756
change_evidence: By the Treaty of Stockholm (1720) Sweden ceded Pomerania south of the Peene and east of the Peenestrom, with Stettin, Usedom, Wollin, Damm and Gollnow, to Prussia. Swedish Pomerania after 1720 lay north of the Peene with Ruegen, bordering Prussian Pomerania and Mecklenburg - not the Margraviate of Brandenburg.
exact_locator: Treaties of Stockholm (Great Northern War); New Western Pomerania
notes: MAPGEN-019 carried this as one of six Brandenburg frontiers. It is not one. The Gartz lead the brief filed under it in fact audits the Uckermark / PRUSSIAN Pomerania line, which is recorded as seg_prussian_pomerania.
